## Definition of done

**The canonical list is in [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md#definition-of-done).** Read
it there. This box is a place to report against it, not a second copy of it —
copies drift, and this one is not allowed to.

Tier is picked once, from the change as a whole; a change touching both docs and
code is a code change.

- [ ] Every gate my tier owes was run, and I have said below which ones and what
      they reported. Anything not run is named, with why.
- [ ] Every issue this change discovered is **closed**, or de-scoped in writing
      by the maintainer. Filing alone does not discharge it.
- [ ] Reviewer findings are fixed, answered, or filed.
